Walnut Wood, Textured Glass, Mixed Materials
Vintage smoking pipe carousel stand manufactured by Decatur Industries, featuring an 8-slot solid walnut rack paired with a textured green glass tobacco humidor jar and a wooden lid topped with an Oscar the Grouch figural finial. Decatur Industries rotating walnut carousel with 8 pipe storage slots
Center textured green glass humidor jar with embossed maker mark on base and Oscar the Grouch lid handle

Wood carousel and green glass jar are well preserved with light surface wear and no chips or cracks. Pipes are in pre-owned estate condition displaying smoke charring, bowl cake, and light stem tooth marks consistent with age and use.

condition. Items are represented to the best of our ability,

previously used  and may contain unseen/hidden flaws which we are unable to ascertain and for which we do not accept responsibility for. completing payment
! If you leave the order screen during checkout on a BIN item, site and order errors can occur! Contact us via a Customer Service Ticket for information regarding BIN item shipping combinations.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97

Hemingray Glass Company
No. 55 Transposition Insulator (CD 205)
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Vintage Early to Mid-20th Century
Vintage Hemingray No. 55 CD 205 aqua glass transposition insulator, historically utilized on rural telephone and power transmission lines to rotate and swap wire positions to minimize electrical crosstalk interference. Manufactured in Muncie, Indiana, this distinctive style of American industrial glass remains a popular favorite among telegraph, utility, and antique glass collectors.
Distinctive transposition profile featuring spiral wire guide channels across the upper dome

Orders are generally shipped within 5 business days of payment.

description: This lot includes a variety of collectible rocks, minerals, and gemstones featuring a granite display piece labeled London Bridge, a quartz geode, and a cluster of raw blue celestite. There are also red coral beads or tumbled stones, a collection of assorted small tumbled stones, and several polished stones such as rose quartz, lapis lazuli, and engraved stones with inscriptions like miracle and harmony. The pieces show natural variations and minor wear consistent with their origins. This diverse set offers a range of sizes, shapes, and colors.

Both trays show a warm brown finish highlighting the wood grain and the crisp carving details. Some age-typical wear and patina are visible, as is light soiling in carved recesses and minor rubbing on corners. Overall, these ashtrays are visually striking and reflect classic craftsmanship, making them ideal display accents or collector's pieces for tobacciana or rustic decor themes.

Raw Earth-Mined Crystals, Points & Rough Chunks
Total Weight: 6.4 lbs
This natural mineral collection features a diverse assortment of quartz specimens totaling approximately 6.4 pounds. Centered around a substantial raw rose quartz rough piece displaying delicate pink coloration and natural crystalline fracturing, the collection also includes an array of clear quartz points, clusters, and raw fragments. Valued by mineral collectors, lapidary crafters, and crystal enthusiasts, these pieces highlight the distinctive geometry and natural clarity characteristic of quartz minerals.
Prominent rough rose quartz specimen measuring approximately 4.5 inches across
Clear quartz crystal points with visible terminations and prismatic striations
Assorted crystalline clusters, rough chunks, and smaller crystal shards

description:
Decorative Stone Egg Lot - 7 Pieces
Polished Marble, Onyx, Calcite, and Mineral Specimens
Includes 2 Ornate Metal Display Stands
A distinctive collection of seven carved and polished natural stone eggs featuring varied mineral compositions, banded patterns, and rich colorations. Polished hardstone eggs have long been collected as tactile curios and decorative accents, showcasing the natural geological beauty of stones such as onyx, marble, and quartz. Each piece exhibits smooth contours and an all-around gloss polish.
Items Included:
Banded onyx/calcite egg with cream and tan strata
White and grey veined marble egg on stand
Cobalt blue quartz/mineral egg on stand
Polished red jasper/marble egg
Bright yellow calcite/alabaster egg
Swirled grey and white marble egg
Petite purple lepidolite/fluorite egg
Two ornate gold-tone metal tripod display stands
Condition:
All eggs remain in good condition with smooth, lustrous finishes. Minor natural mineral pits and internal fissures characteristic of authentic stone lapidary specimens. Both metal tripod stands are structurally sound and stable with light age-appropriate patina.

description:
Set of 3 Vintage Hemingray 42 and Whitall Tatum Glass Insulators
This set includes three vintage glass insulators used for telegraph or power lines. It features two Hemingray-42 insulators, one in aqua blue glass and one in clear glass, both embossed with branding and model numbers. The set also includes one Whitall Tatum Co. insulator in light blue aqua glass with embossed markings. Each insulator has ridged designs and domed tops characteristic of early to mid-20th century utility glassware. These pieces show minor wear consistent with vintage use and are suitable for collectors interested in historical or decorative items.

description:
Art Glass Cullet Chunk
Cobalt Blue with Rainbow Iridescent Finish
Decorative Glass Specimen, 1.365 Pounds
Substantial decorative chunk of cobalt blue cullet slag glass displaying a vibrant iridescent carnival-style flash across fractured planes and smooth surfaces. Raw glass chunks like this were produced during the glassmaking process at heritage American glassworks, where excess furnace glass cooled into monolithic blocks before being fractured into decorative specimens prized for garden displays, lapidary projects, and paperweights.
Intense translucent cobalt blue glass body with rich color depth
Exterior exhibits strong rainbow iridescence in vivid hues of gold, magenta, and turquoise
Natural conchoidal fracturing showcasing glass cleavage, smooth waves, and raw crystalline textures
Measures approximately 4 inches by 2.25 inches by 3.25 inches; weighs 1.365 pounds
Condition:
Formed as a raw fractured glass chunk with natural sharp edges, conchoidal ridges, and cleavage faces inherent to slag glass. Clean surfaces with brilliant luster and no post-manufacture cloudiness or chemical damage.

title: Polished Gemstone & Crystal Wand Collection Quartz Cluster Selenite 2.2 lbs
description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The specimens exhibit natural geological features, including internal fractures and surface textures inherent to natural minerals. The tumbled stones have a smooth, high-polish finish. The quartz cluster shows minor contact marks and natural inclusions typical of geological specimens.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
